html: כבב (√ of foll., cf. Sta§ 116, 3; meaning not wholly clear; Arabic كَبَّ is roll threads into a ball, كُبَّةٌ ball of thread, but also troop of horses, band of men, etc.; Ethiopic ከበበ is in orbem circumsistere, ከባብ, ክባብ orbis, circulus, etc.; hence perhaps star, as round, or as collected in bands, clusters, constellations; Assyrian kabâbu = burn; kabâbê, shields, is written ḳabâbê by DlHWB578).
